name: Meter
description: How much of an allowance is left, such as a usage limit that resets. Takes what is `used`; the bar shows what is left, full to start and draining. The info fill, like Progress, until `low` or less is left, then the warning color; never danger, and no success color at full.

props.name: low
props.description: When as much as this is left, or less, the meter is low and takes the warning color ("at or below", unlike HTML's `<meter low>`, which is strictly below). In the units of `max`, clamped to 0 to `max`.

props.name: max
props.description: The whole allowance, in the same units as `used`.

props.name: used
props.description: How much of the allowance is used, as the provider reports it, from 0 to `max`. The meter draws and announces what is left: `max - used`.

props.name: valueText
props.description: What is left, in words: "38% left · resets in 3h". `MeterValue` shows it, and it is the meter's `aria-valuetext`, so the caller writes it once.

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component.
